AGENDA

Certificate of Recognition Sponsors
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF JULY 26, 2011 AND AUGUST 9, 2011
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of July 26, 2011 and August 9, 2011.

CC.A-1 08-09-2011 Minutes CC Reg
A-2
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF AUGUST 15, 2011

CC.A-2 08-15-2011 CC CDC Adj Reg
A-3
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF AUGUST 15, 2011
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of August 15, 2011.
CC.A-3 08-15-2011 Spc CC Minutes
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1309 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011-12
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1309.
CC.D-1 Resoultion Warrant Register #1309
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE SUBMISSION OF AN APPLICATION TO THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA FOR 2011 CALHOME PROGRAM GRANT FUNDS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached Resolution authorizing the submittal of an application for CalHome Program funds in the amount of $473,940.
CC.D-2 CalHome Application resolution Report
CC.D-2 CalHome Application resolution Att A
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION REQUESTING THAT LOS ANGELES COUNTY PROVIDE THE CITY WITH SPECIFIED SERVICES FOR THE CITY'S GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION OF TUESDAY, APRIL 10, 2012
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to Render Specified Services to the City Relating to the Conduct of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, April 10, 2012.
CC.D-3 Staff Report County Election Services
CC.D-3 Resolution Requesting County Election Services
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF AWARDING FIVE ADDITIONAL SCHOLARSHIPS IN THE AMOUNT OF FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS EACH, FOR ACADEMIC YEAR 2011-12
It is recommended that the City Council award the five outstanding scholarships, each in the amount of $500, for the 2011-12 academic year.
CC.D-4 Awarding 5 Additional Scholarship Report
CC.D-4 Awarding 5 Additional Scholarships List
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1309 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011-12
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1309.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN AGREEMENT WITH AGINCOURT CONSULTANT SERVICES FOR CODE ENFORCEMENT SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $28,800
It is recommended that the City Council Approve agreement with Agincourt Consultant Services for code enforcement services for a total amount not to exceed $28,800, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement, subject to review and approval by the City Attorney as to form.
CC.E-1 Contract Code Enforcement agreement report
CC.E-1 Professional Services Agreement Agincourt Consulting
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE CITY'S PARTICIPATION IN THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY'S RELAY FOR LIFE LA PUENTE 2012, AND USE OF CITY FACILITIES (Councilmember House)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-3
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING AMENDING AND UPDATING THE CITY'S GENERAL PLAN (Councilmember House)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-4
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING FLOODING LOCATIONS WITHIN THE CITY (Councilmember Holloway)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF TAKING THE MATTER OF ENTERING INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH FOR ELECTION OFFICIAL SERVICES OFF OF THE TABLE (Mayor Solis)
It is recommended that the City Council 1) take the item of selecting a firm to perform election official services off of the table.
CC.E-5 Election Official Services Report and Taking item off of Table
E-6
CONSIDERATION AND SELECTION OF A FIRM TO PERFORM ELECTION OFFICIAL SERVICES FOR THE CITY'S APRIL 2012 GENERAL MUNICPAL ELECTION (Mayor Solis)
Assuming item E-6 is approved, it is recommended that the City Council 1) adopt the Resolution; and 2) Approve entering into a professional services agreement, subject to review and approval by the City Attorney as to form, with one of the three firms that have submitted a written proposal.
CC.E-6 Election Officail Services Report and Selection of a Firm
CC.E-6 Duties of the Election Official Scope of Services Att A
CC.E-6 Election Official Services Reso Att B
CC.E-6 City Clerk Municipal Services Att C
CC.E-6 Election Proposal Carol Cowley Att D
CC.E-6 Election Proposal Linda Hudson Att E
E-7
RECOMMENDATION REGARDING THE SELECTION OF VOTING MEMBERS FOR THE HOLIDAY HOME DECORATING CONTEST
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the recommendation of the City Staff to form a panel of seven voting members for the Holiday Home Decorating Contest comprised of two members of the City Council, three members of the La Puente Pride Committee, and two City Staff members.
CC.E-7 Recommendation for the Selection of the Judging Panel for the Holiday Home Decorating Contest
E-6
CONSIDERATION AND SELECTION OF A FIRM TO PERFORM ELECTION OFFICIAL SERVICES FOR THE CITY'S APRIL 2012 GENERAL MUNICPAL ELECTION (Mayor Solis)
Assuming item E-6 is approved, it is recommended that the City Council 1) adopt the Resolution; and 2) Approve entering into a professional services agreement, subject to review and approval by the City Attorney as to form, with one of the three firms that have submitted a written proposal.
E-6
CONSIDERATION AND SELECTION OF A FIRM TO PERFORM ELECTION OFFICIAL SERVICES FOR THE CITY'S APRIL 2012 GENERAL MUNICPAL ELECTION (Mayor Solis)
Assuming item E-6 is approved, it is recommended that the City Council 1) adopt the Resolution; and 2) Approve entering into a professional services agreement, subject to review and approval by the City Attorney as to form, with one of the three firms that have submitted a written proposal.
